name: gurukripa-estate
description: Gurukripa Estate — MERN real estate website with a separate admin panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,site,admin -c green,yellow,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
